purpose: Local preparation plan; not an executable trainer configuration or a capacity measurement.

hardware.selection_source: User explicitly selected A800 x4 80GB for post-training.

model_and_adapter.base_family: official Gemma4 31B QAT-unquantized, immutable source identity to be resolved before execution

coldstart_data.current_data_kind: Codex-authored, source-reviewed actual-tool off-policy coldstart demonstrations; not current-policy RL data

candidate_coldstart_execution.DDP_memory_layout: A full frozen base replica on each GPU; four cards are not one contiguous 320GB address space.
candidate_coldstart_execution.sampling_note: 400+200 defines distinct task inventory, not a new mixture-weight decision; preserve explicit source and task grouping.
candidate_coldstart_execution.memory_fallback: If complete 10699-token examples do not fit BF16 DDP, implement true BF16 sharding. Do not silently truncate data or switch the base to NF4.

integration_work_before_execution: Adapt gemma-human-action-sft-v2 input_ids/assistant_loss_mask into trainer attention_mask/labels with exact token preservation; keep actual authored off-policy provenance rather than inventing on-policy or human annotation.

Bind the actual tokenizer object fingerprint, complete template and normalized six-tool protocol; the raw tokenizer-file SHA is not the old tokenizer_fingerprint(). Do not re-render or truncate the official generation prefixes.
The old train_fsdp entrypoint and its checkpoint initialization are NF4-specific; BF16 sharding requires an explicit implementation branch rather than only changing YAML.
Save/export adapter tensors as actual BF16. Current exporters preserve tensor dtype and do not establish BF16 merely from BF16 compute.
Select the actual CUDA/NCCL/interconnect settings on the A800 host. The old A40 NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 was specific to that host and is not a default here.

Wire the new8K-total/32K-context/positive-thinking budget policy into sampling, count the exact serialized prefix and enforce the joint context limit. Preserve thinking0 coldstart version; collect authentic positive-thinking traces and keep focal-pair budget conditions identical.

research_stages.name: Real six-tool coldstart
research_stages.input: The prepared 400 common +200 S specialist tasks and actual assistant-action masks.
research_stages.output: A source- and policy-identified S r32 coldstart adapter; no repair gain claimed before real evaluation.

research_stages.name: Verified focal recovery collection
research_stages.input: Actual current-policy failures on allowed train tasks.
research_stages.output: Restored pre-error states, identical visible prefix and logical remaining budget, original-action replay and alternative branches with real terminal verification.

research_stages.name: Verified Focal Agent RL with budget-aware optimization
research_stages.input: Only the actually collected outcome/group/logprob/reference-policy evidence appropriate to each objective.
research_stages.output: The user-specified local preference/task-and-state advantage/KL-replay research combination; not represented as an already implemented or validated algorithm.
research_stages.time_cost_calibration: Use actual A800 policy generation and tool times; CPU scripted replay time is not GPU policy inference time.

limitations: Hardware chosen and data prepared. Trainer integration, actual A800 memory/throughput, model cache identity, platform and session compute budget are not yet established. No GPU or model training was started in this preparation.
